'''''Akebia longeracemosa''''' or '''long-racemed akebia'''<ref>{{Cite web |title=Akebia longeracemosa {{!}} long-racemed akebia Climber Wall Shrub/RHS Gardening |url=http://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/126923/akebia-longeracemosa/details |access-date=2023-01-09 |website=www.rhs.org.uk |language=en-gb}}</ref> is a member of the '''chocolate vine''' genus, ''[[Akebia]]'', and more specifically a relative of the commonly known, ''[[Akebia quinata]].''

== Description ==
It is a twining, semi-evergreen climbing vine which grows up to 8m tall with bright green foliage comprising five, oblong leaflets that may be tinged purple in winter. Fragrant, cup-shaped, purple-red spring flowers borne in pendulous racemes to 15cm long may be followed by purplish, sausage-shaped fruits if cross pollination between two separate species or varieties occurs.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Akebia longeracemosa {{!}} long-racemed akebia Climber Wall Shrub/RHS Gardening |url=http://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/126923/akebia-longeracemosa/details |access-date=2023-01-09 |website=www.rhs.org.uk |language=en-gb}}</ref>

Morphological and molecular evidence suggests that ''A. longeracemosa'' is possibly a hybrid between ''[[Akebia quinata|A. quinata]]'' and ''[[Akebia trifoliata|A. trifoliata]]''.<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Xiao |first1=Xiong |last2=Deng |first2=Huisheng |last3=Xu |first3=Lingling |last4=Wen |first4=Feng |last5=Han |first5=Xingjie |last6=Liao |first6=Liang |last7=Li |first7=Tongjian |date=2021-03-04 |title=The complete chloroplast genome of Akebia longeracemosa (Lardizabalaceae) |url=https://doi.org/10.1080/23802359.2021.1884018 |journal=Mitochondrial DNA Part B |volume=6 |issue=3 |pages=826–827 |doi=10.1080/23802359.2021.1884018 |pmc=7954470 |pmid=33763592}}</ref>

== Uses ==

=== Culinary ===
Like most species of ''Akebia'', ''A. longeracemosa'' can be eaten and produces purple fruiting bodies similar to ''[[Akebia quinata|A. quinata]]'' however there is a lack of information regarding the flavor of this species in particular.<ref name=":0" />
